claims: The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade and Festival is on Saturday, March 14, 2026.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade starts at 11 AM on Greenville Avenue at Blackwell Street.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade ends at SMU Blvd around 2 PM.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade and Festival is the biggest St. Paddy's celebration in Texas.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade and Festival features over 90 floats.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade and Festival features food trucks.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade and Festival features a 5K race.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade runs from 11 AM to 2 PM.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Festival runs from 9 AM to 3 PM.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade and Festival is located on Greenville Avenue between Park Lane and SMU Blvd, Dallas, TX.
The 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade and Festival is free to attend.
St. Patrick's Day Dash 5K occurs on the morning of the 45th Annual Dallas Mavericks St. Patrick’s Parade.
Lower Greenville Block Party is located on Lower Greenville.
Lower Greenville Block Party runs from 9 AM to 6 PM.
Lower Greenville Block Party features live music.
Www.dallasstpp.com is the official parade website.
